name: Basma Adeem Medical Co.
summary: Basma Adeem Medical Co. specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of dental and dermatological services. Their extensive medical offerings encompass various procedures, including outpatient (one-day) surgery, orthodontic treatments, and advanced maxillofacial surgery. Within dentistry, they provide periodontal surgery, dental implants, root canal therapy (endodontics), general oral and dental health services, and a wide array of restorative, cosmetic, and prosthodontic dental solutions, alongside dedicated pediatric dentistry. Additionally, the company offers comprehensive dermatology and laser treatments. Founded on November 13, 2012, its operations are headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
